data.title: 五和 · 榻榻米被褥间的纯白羞涩献身
data.description: 静谧的日式卧室内暖光微昏。纯白棉质吊带睡裙从雪白香肩彻底滑落，双手按在胸前轻颤的五和满面绯红，眼泛泪光地依偎在你的胸膛上，软软低语“请让我……成为上条先生真正的人吧”。
data.location: traditional Japanese bedroom with soft white futon
data.action: 满面绯红，眼泛泪光地依偎在你的胸膛上，软软低语
data.lighting: soft warm amber floor lamp illuminating pale curves and flushed cheeks
data.promptProse: Inside a hushed Japanese bedroom warmed by a low floor lamp, Itsuwa leans tenderly into her partner's chest on the futon, her flushed face glistening with happy tears as she whispers softly.
data.animaCaption: Pressing close against her partner's chest on the dimly lit tatami futon with hands trembling softly over her heart, she looks up through tear-misted eyes and crimson blush as her pure white cotton slip nightdress slides off her bare shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: Her soft white cotton camisole nightdress slips down off both shoulders, uncovering her bare collarbones and upper cleavage as she clings closely.
